localOrigin: normalized model bottom; before optional floorDatumOffset
method: 10cm conservative XZ voxels intersected against all actual source triangles within the vertical body envelope, greedily merged into boxes
limitations: Detailed collision boxes cover the standing visitor body interval; one conservative upper enclosure prevents untracked roof collisions when resized. Not a full 3D physics hull.
Floor still requires matching source support or an explicit ramp/floor-datum treatment; this does not declare a 30cm step walkable.
Box rasterization is conservative: a blocked path may still be traversable in the original mesh, but the reverse must not be assumed.
Source includes detailed ornaments; final furniture must be checked against the shell and its own clearance envelope.
